subject: Re: Leadership in Austin 19/20 of Nov
text:
Hi [NAME],

We've been in touch with Chris Merz and others from your perception team,
and since you're based in Austin, wanted to reach out. Our leadership team
will be there on the 19th/20th Nov meeting customers, and would love to
grab a coffee if you're around - happy to come to you.

For context, we're an ML DataOps platform that unifies data curation,
annotation and model eval under on platform. We've partnered with companies
in the autonomous systems space like Woven by Toyota and Zipline to
consolidate their 2D and 3D pipelines, and we're quite familiar with the
defence domain as well having worked with Shield AI, The Royal Navy and few
others.

Let me know if you're around and I can help set something up.

subject: Re: Leadership in Austin 19/20 November
text:
Hi [NAME],

Some of our leadership team will be in the Austin for Nov 19th and 20th
meeting up with a few of our customers. I noticed you're based there and
working in CV with BNSF, so I wanted to reach out to see if you'd be open
to grabbing a quick coffee while they're in town.

BNSF has been on our radar for a while - we've worked with teams like Otiv
on fusing 2D and 3D pipelines, as well as Zeitview and Skydio on automated
inspection, safety monitoring, and predictive maintenance use cases.

If Encord is new to you, we're a multimodal DataOps platform that unifies
data curation, annotation, workflow management, and model observability
under one roof. Thought it be a good chance to connect and share our
perspectives.

Let me know if you're be in Austin those days and interested in meeting -
they'd be happy to swing by your office?

subject: Coffee in Austin - humanoid perception
text:
Hi [NAME],

We just onboarded 1X, who like [COMPANY] is building models to understand &
interact with complex human environments. We'll be in Austin next week &
wanted to see if you'd be up for a coffee? Thought you might find what
we've learned interesting.

Where Encord focuses on: improving data quality when real-world data
collection scales up. That's why we're unifying 2D and LiDAR annotation and
VLM captioning in one platform - a niche we developed with robotics teams
e.g. Physical Intelligence, Boston Dynamics, and Dyna Robotics.

Would you be open to exchange perspectives? We're in Austin Wed (10/19) to
Thurs (10/20) next week - can swing by your office or meet at a coffee shop
nearby.

subject: [NAME] - Encord
text:
Hi [NAME],

Did you get the chance to download the E-MM1 dataset? Curious which
modalities you're working with at [COMPANY]'s AI Lab.

We work with leading GenAI teams like Synthesia, Twelve Labs, and Captions,
helping them automate annotation and data labeling for supervised
fine-tuning/RLHF and preference ranking for model evaluations.

I'd love to better understand your use cases and show how Encord could fit
into your stack and speed up data throughput and model iteration.

I'm flexible Tuesdays to Fridays PST- would any time work for a quick call?

subject: Re: Leadership in Austin 19th/20th Nov
text:
Hi [NAME],

I was revisiting earlier conversations Blinkfire (Nan and Evelyn) had with
Encord, specifically in regard to ML pipelines, and noticed you're based in
Austin. Some of our leadership team will be there on the 19/20th of Nov, so
wanted to reach out to see if you'd like to grab an in-person coffee with
them?

In case you're unfamiliar, Encord is a data development platform for CV and
multimodal AI. We help 200+ AI teams improve training data quality by
unifying data curation, visualisation, annotation, and model evaluation in
one place.

We're video-native (no need to render into frames) and work with teams like
SportsRadar, MVPIndex, and the NBA on computer vision models for sports
analytics and sponsorship performance tracking.

Thought it would be a good chance to reconnect with the Blinkfire team -
let me know  if you're around and I send across some times that could work.
